title: SCREAM Radio: Soundtrack Your Halloween with Scary Sounds, Songs, and Stories
summary: Listen to this fan-favorite annual channel beginning October 22.
body_markdown:
It’s time to don your[Halloween](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/halloween-radio) costume, gorge on candy, and, of course, SCREAM! SiriusXM’s destination for chills and thrills returns as SCREAM Radio fills the airwaves with a spooky soundtrack for Halloween.


[SCREAM Radio Available Oct 22–Nov 4 Coming Soon Coming Soon](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSCREAMRadio)


## **SCREAM Radio**


### **How to Listen**


SiriusXM listeners can find SCREAM Radio on satellite channel 300 and[stream it on the SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSCREAMRadio) from Thursday, October 22 through November 4, 2026.


**Note:** Channel 300 may not be available on some radios, but there are other ways to listen in your car with the SiriusXM app.


- **Related:[10 Scary Podcasts That Will Totally Creep You Out This Halloween](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/scary-horror-podcasts-halloween/)**


### **What You’ll Hear**


Enjoy nonstop creepy vibes, music from your favorite classic and current horror films, and original scary stories voiced by SiriusXM talent.


### **Share Your Haunted Story to Be Heard On Air**


Got a chilling, unsettling, can’t-sleep-after-reading-it story? SiriusXM’s new[Haunted Hotline](http://siriusxm.com/hauntedhotline) is giving fans the chance to share their scariest tales by voice or text and potentially hear them brought to life on air. Submit your scary story now through Thursday, October 15, then share your favorite Halloween plans and costumes from Friday, October 16 through Wednesday, November 4.


[Share your most terrifying tale Submit a Message Submit a Message](http://siriusxm.com/hauntedhotline)


### **More Halloween on SiriusXM**


Throughout October, find the creepiest collection of Halloween treats anyone could ask for on the SiriusXM app, including wicked music mixes, eerie sound effects, scare-filled stories, paranormal podcasts, and more.


[Halloween on SiriusXM Music mixes, scary podcasts, stories & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSCREAMRadio-HalloweenCollection)
